dosage_and_administration: Directions Scalp Treatment: Section hair into 4 parts exposing scalp. Apply a small amount of oil to scalp, massage oil in with fingers and comb through to ends of hair. Leave in and style as desired. Daily Use: Apply a small amount to scalp and comb through to ends. Split End Care: Apply oil to ends of hair, place a processing cap on head and leave on for 10 minutes. Rinse and proceed with shampooing.
